BiblicalUsage: Kope is a cutting, a slaughter. Hebrews 7:1 tells how Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the slaughter is the setting of the blessing: Abraham comes back from the battle, and the priest of the most high God meets him with bread and wine.
